Why PlantPal

One sensor, three things your plant has been trying to tell you.

No app-hopping, no guesswork. Clip it in, and PlantPal translates soil, light, and air into plain instructions.

Knows before it wilts

A soil probe checks moisture every 20 minutes and sends a nudge to your phone two full days before your plant would actually feel thirsty.

Finds its own sunspot

The light sensor learns how your room shifts through the seasons and tells you when it's time to move your plant six inches to the left.

Speaks plainly, not in charts

Instead of raw numbers, the PlantPal app says things like "water in 2 days" — so you can act on it without becoming a botanist first.
